mechanisms.fact: A membership value is HELD by the row that carries it when it rides on the arm's own write: a CORRELATED arm's target is the row this row's membership already names, so a write of the referenced key moves this row with it (ON UPDATE CASCADE) BEFORE this row's own statement runs. The held value is neither the payload (what the statement will LEAVE) nor a request (what it submits) — it is the row between the two. Every `before` child having run, the observation this operation holds of the row is re-addressed from it, so the record's own UPDATE where-clause, a sibling child-held lookup's membership, a descendant create's foreign key and the terminal read all name the row where the cascade left it; every member of a compound key is published, not only the ones the payload spelled. A SUPPLIER earlier in the same body (`connect` and its kin run before `update`/`upsert` in `mutationOrder`) names a different row, and then it is this row's own statement that moves it and the located key that addresses it — so the hold is exactly `binding.carried?.writesField(referenced) && !destination.writesField(field)`.

mechanisms.fact: PLACEMENT, not verb, decides which key a correlated arm's lookup names. A CHILD-HELD arm is placed AFTER the parent's write (`association`'s `placement`), so the key valid there is the one that write left the row holding — under a key transition the provider has already moved the child's foreign key onto it, and the pre-transition key names no member at all. The parent's own `Assignments` are that answer at every point, which is why a nested `update` placed BEFORE the write reads them too. A parent-held `upsert` alone cannot read them (its create arm contributes the chosen row's key into those same assignments, so correlating on them is a read of its own write, which no order satisfies, N1) and keeps its view of the same two answers. This is N3c's withdrawn finding placed where its review said it belongs: `parent: verb === "update" && edge.kind !== "junction" ? parent.fields : parent.located!.fields` became `edge.owner !== "source" || verb === "update"`.
